name: Tahitian Vanilla Crème Brûlée
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's
whyItWorks: Unlike the Grand Marnier Soufflé (which contains orange liqueur), the Tahitian Vanilla Crème Brûlée is 100% citrus-free, seedless, and zero-fiber.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Take 1–2 Lactaid tablets with the first bite of baked cream custard and leave any fresh strawberry/berry garnish on the plate.
watchOuts: Skip raw berry garnish if flaring
